## Changed

- Pushing a tag now builds and publishes the **Linux** and **macOS*** bundles only. 
  Windows are no longer built on every release.
- Windows builds are now run on demand: Actions → Release → Run
  workflow, giving it the tag and the platforms. The artifacts are attached to
  the release the tag push already created, and the checkout is pinned to the
  tag, so a manual run started from a branch still builds the tagged commit.
